capabilities: Record writing activity metrics (manual input, added, deleted, net)
Display writing intensity in a sidebar calendar and yearly heatmaps
Set daily, weekly, and monthly writing goals
Run an optional focus timer with active, idle, and away time
Compare file statistics against a baseline to flag suspicious changes
extras: README warns not to delete the 写作日历数据/ folder since historical ledgers cannot be fully restored, and that devices syncing plugin data must be updated together because older versions cannot read compressed indexes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track how much you actually write per day or visualize writing activity and streaks over time.
summary: Local-first writing statistics plugin that records daily writing activity and presents it as a calendar, heatmaps, goals, and an optional focus timer.
